messages:
leah-cs: Heads up — customer flagged that per-model throughput sparklines in Console are flatlined for all models since the 06:30 deploy. Overall QPS panel shows traffic, but the per-model lines are a single flatline at 0. Screenshot: https://files.internal/snap-210345.png
maria-support: Thanks — which customer, and any request IDs? I have an open ticket.
leah-cs: Acme Corp, ticket #AC-992. Request samples: rcvd from api-prod-1. They say latency fine and endpoints return 200s. Only Console per-model graphs empty.
aj: I can take a look — quick grep shows exporter change in the metrics-agent PR that went live this morning. Commit: https://git.internal/redwood/metrics-agent/commit/8f3b2a. It renamed label `model` -> `model_id` in prometheus metrics (exporter now emits model_id).
tom_sre: Confirmed from scrape: `model_throughput_total{model_id="gptx-1",instance="m-01"} 12345` — no `model` label present. Dashboards were authored against `model` label, so grafana template var no longer matches.
maria-support: Oof. Customer expects per-model breakdown in Console, right now it groups by nothing so shows aggregated total but per-model series missing. Any quick workaround we can tell them?
aj: Quick workaround in PromQL: use label_replace to synthesize `model` from `model_id` at query time. Example for the panel query:  `label_replace(sum by (model) (rate(model_throughput_total[1m])), "model", "$1", "model_id", "(.*)")` — that will recover series in Grafana without redeploying dashboards.
leah-cs: Can we push a temporary fix in the Console for the customer's org so they see per-model?
aj: I pushed a cluster-level recording rule to shadow the old label for now — created rule `model_throughput_by_model` which copies `model_id` -> `model`. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/PR/462. It will take a few minutes to evaluate in Prometheus.
deploy-bot: deploy ops-prometheus/rules v1.3.2 started by aj at 2103456802
ci-bot: smoke check: rules applied, evals ok
tom_sre: After rule applied, grafana panels that use `model` are populating again for us. Verified with `sum by (model) (rate(model_throughput_total[1m]))` — shows lines.
maria-support: Awesome — can you give me the exact message I should send to Acme with steps to verify on their side?
aj: Tell them to refresh Console dashboard and check per-model sparkline; if they have a cached dashboard URL they should do a full refresh. Also option to run this curl against Prometheus if they have access: `curl -g 'https://prom.internal/api/v1/query?query=sum%20by%20(model)(rate(model_throughput_total[1m]))'`
leah-cs: I'm going to message the customer and add a note that we applied a temporary recording rule.
aj: Long-term fix: I opened issue to add a compatibility label in the exporter that emits `model` alongside `model_id` (so both labels present), and to update dashboard templates to accept either. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/metrics-agent/PR/198 — it adds relabel config snippet: ```yaml-plain
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["model_id"]
    target_label: "model"
    replacement: "$1"
    action: replace
```
We also need a small Console patch to prefer `model` if present else fallback to `model_id` when building template vars.
maria-support: ETA for full fix? Customer asked for timeline.
aj: I marked the PR as high priority — aiming for deploy within 48 hours. Will coordinate with infra for a canary.
tom_sre: Recommend also adding a CI check that rejects exporter PRs that remove historically-used label names without a compat shim. Created POLICY ticket: https://tickets.internal/RED-679.
leah-cs: Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer and close the ticket when they confirm per-model lines are back. :thumbsup:
